title: XSD numeric datatype value family
api_or_output: Internal XSD datatype family implementation; no partial public validator

acceptance.description: Implement XSD1.0 decimal/integer/float/double and all built-in numeric derivations through the verified core family contract. Retain arbitrary decimal/integer precision, exact built-in ranges, INF/-INF/NaN/signed-zero behavior and prescribed equality/order/hash including compatible derived numeric values. No CLR decimal/double truncation for arbitrary decimal/integer values.

Test valid/invalid lexical grammar, insignificant zeros, large magnitudes/precision, range edges, NaN/infinities/zero signs, cross-numeric equality/hash/order and applicable digit measures. Charge actual lexical/conversion/comparison work and bounded growth, with exact-limit, one-over and cancellation cases.

Compile against only verified model/core dependencies; record focused regression and meaningful allocation/performance evidence at the tested source. Preserve public APIs and leave final library dispatch/composition to M8-datatypes.

handoff.summary: Planned bounded child of M8-datatypes; original complete XSD1.0 acceptance and gate reachability preserved.
